parameters.command: ={{ (() => { const value = $('Settings').first().json.rcloneConfigBase64; if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/.test(value) || !value.trim()) throw new Error('Set rcloneConfigBase64 in Settings before running.'); const config = value.replace(/\s/g, ''); return "RCLONE_CONFIG_CONTENT='" + config + "' bash /opt/scripts/backup-to-remote/backup.sh run --json"; })() }}
